d: "When huge alligators turn up in ponds, backyards and unexpected places, the Gator Boys are ready to take action! Paul Bedard, Jimmy Riffle and Ashley Lawrence tackle some of their most daring alligator rescue missions across Florida and Mississippi. From aggressive nuisance alligators to massive reptiles that put every capture to the test, these alligator trappers rely on skill, courage and quick thinking to get the job done.
